title.value: Compare products and submit web forms with browser control

introduction.value: Gemini's computer use model compared two action cameras on PB Tech and found a company site via Google, filled in and submitted a contact form that arrived minutes later.

method.value: Blake Harkness gave Gemini's computer use model plain-language prompts. The model works in a loop: it screenshots the browser, analyses the image, picks an action, then clicks or types, repeating until the task is done. It searched PB Tech for both cameras. In a second test it found the Harkness AI site through Google and completed the contact form.

outcome.value: In about 3 minutes it reported the GoPro Hero 13 at $569 against the DJI Action 5 at $759. The form submission worked, and the inquiry reached Blake's inbox five minutes later.

notes.value: The source flags security risk: agents acting with your credentials could be tricked by adversarial websites. The tests were simple, low-stakes tasks.

source_text.body:
Compare products and submit web forms with browser control
Gemini's computer use model compared two action cameras on PB Tech and found a company site via Google, filled in and submitted a contact form that arrived minutes later.
Done with
GE
Gemini
What they did
Blake Harkness gave Gemini's computer use model plain-language prompts. The model works in a loop: it screenshots the browser, analyses the image, picks an action, then clicks or types, repeating until the task is done. It searched PB Tech for both cameras. In a second test it found the Harkness AI site through Google and completed the contact form.
How it went
In about 3 minutes it reported the GoPro Hero 13 at $569 against the DJI Action 5 at $759. The form submission worked, and the inquiry reached Blake's inbox five minutes later.
Worth knowing
The source flags security risk: agents acting with your credentials could be tricked by adversarial websites. The tests were simple, low-stakes tasks.
Try it yourself
with
Gemini
Copy prompt
Open [retailer website] and compare [product A] and [product B] on price, key specs, and customer ratings, then give me a short side-by-side summary with a recommendation. Next, find the contact page for [company name] and fill in the form with this message: [your message], using my name [name] and email [email]. Stop before pressing submit and show me the completed form to confirm.
Original source: https://www.harknessai.nz/articles/gemini-browser-control-computer-use-impressions
